description: Executes multiple database operations in one request.

Stops the search operation mid-way. This method can be used when the search operation takes a long time to return results or required to search with another keyword without waiting for previous search results. It is not applicable to situations where the search method returns results immediately. Note: For this method to work, the search() API must be configured with the 'cancelable' parameter set to 'true'.

params.taskId: String (required) Unique identifier of the search operation. Obtained using the search() API.

description: The compact method invokes the low level garbage collector. When DB8 executes a del operation without Purge:True param, it only marks the object as to be deleted. The object will be removed by DB8, when the garbage collector is called. To call the garbage collector manually, the client can call the compact method. This command is implemented only for the LevelDB and Sandwich engine.

description: The mergePut method updates the properties of existing objects. If an object doesn't exist, a new one will be created in the database. The object to be updated can be specified in one of the following ways: A query An array of IDs

params.objects: Object array (optional) The object parameter is an array of objects, each object will have an id and key/value pairs that represent the object properties the app needs to merge. This is required if the query parameter is not specified.
params.query: Object: Query (optional) The query parameter is a Query object specifying the set of objects whose properties the app wants to update. The query parameter is required if the object parameter is not specified.
params.props: Object (optional) The props parameter is an object with key/value pairs that specify the set of properties to be merged into the existing object(s) specified in the query parameter. If the app specifies the properties in the prop parameter, the query is required.

notes: Listed under ACG group "database.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/mergePut (params copied from that record).

description: Enables or disables DB8 profiling for an application. When enabled, profiling data is stored for the application. You can enable DB8 profiling using one of the following approaches: - Self enabling: In this approach, the 3rd-party application enables profiling on itself (see example 1). - Enable profiling using admin-privileged applications: In the approach, an admin-privileged application controls DB8 profiling for 3rd-party applications. Use this approach when you want the admin to control the profiling of 3rd-party applications. You can choose to enable profiling for a single application or for all 3rd-party applications. See example 2 and 3.

params.enable: Boolean (optional) Status of DB8 profiling. Possible values: TRUE, FALSE Default value: TRUE
params.application: String (optional) Name of application to be profiled. If no name is specified, the current/caller application is profiled. If name is given as *, all applications are profiled. The caller application must have admin permissions.

notes: Listed under ACG group "database.profiling" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/profile (params copied from that record).

description: Marks an external media as transient for the specified DB8 shard Id. This means that all data, relative to the shard, are not required by any application and will be removed by garbage collector. In other words, marking shard as transient will wipe all data from the shard on the nearest garbage collector call.

description: The compact method invokes the low level garbage collector. When DB8 executes a del operation without Purge:True param, it only marks the object as to be deleted. The object will be removed by DB8, when the garbage collector is called. To call the garbage collector manually, the client can call the compact method. This command is implemented only for the LevelDB and Sandwich engine.

description: The del method deletes JSON data objects from the database. Apps can specify the objects to be deleted by providing: a set of IDs to be deleted a DB8 query

params.ids: String array (optional) The ids parameter contains an array of JSON object ids that you wish to delete. If you do not wish to specify JSON object IDs, you must specify a query in the query parameter.
params.query: Object: Query (optional) The query parameter contains a query for a set of objects to be deleted. If you do not wish to specify a query, you must specify a list of JSON object ids in the ids parameter.
params.purge: Boolean (optional) The default value of the purge parameter is false . If the purge parameter is set to false , the target objects will only be marked for deletion. Objects marked for deletion can still be restored. They will be purged permanently only when an administrative purge operation is run. If the purge parameter is set to true , the target objects will be deleted permanently immediately.

description: The find method returns a set of objects that match the query specified in the query parameter. The app can specify the number of results to return. However, if the app does not want to specify a limit, it can set the count parameter to true . This will cause the find method to return the total number of results. The app can also request to be notified if any of the returned results from the query change in the future. In order to receive change notifications, set the watch parameter to true . The find method supports distinct groups enabling the app to remove duplicate objects.

params.query: Object: Query (required) DB8 query for retrieving results.
params.count: Boolean (optional) The default value of the count parameter is false . If the app did not specify a limit on the number of results to return, and wants to know the total number of results returned, the app should set the count parameter to true .
params.watch: Boolean (optional) The default value of the watch parameter is false . If an app wants to be notified about any change in the returned results, the app should set the watch parameter to true .
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscription is enabled if true.

description: Enables or disables DB8 profiling for an application. When enabled, profiling data is stored for the application. description: The put method stores JSON data objects of a particular Kind into the database. The put method will: Assign an id field to each object, if it was not set. Return the id and rev for each stored object.

params.objects: Object array (required) List of JSON data objects of a particular kind that the app wants to store in the database.

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/put (params copied from that record).

description: The putKind method registers a kind with the database. Kinds define the owner, and the indexes for a JSON data object. Indexes can be composed of single or multiple properties. When you create your index, be aware that queries can only return results that are indexed, and are contiguously ordered. If your app or service wants to be notified only when a subset of an object's properties are updated, then you can use revision sets. If your app or service creates objects that other apps or services need to access, then see the putPermissions method for more information.

params.id: String (required) Id of the kind to be registered with the database.
params.owner: String (required) Owner of the kind. Only the owner has permission to modify the created kind. Use the ID of the app/service which calls the putKind method. App/service can only create kinds that they are the owner of. But it is possible to grant access to the created kind to other apps/services using the putPermission method.
params.schema: Object (optional) JSON Syntax for data objects of a specific kind. If set, this kind's data objects are validated before being stored. For details refer to http://json-schema.org/documentation.html
params.sync: Boolean (optional) The sync parameter allows apps to enable backing up and restoring specific kinds of objects. The default value for the sync parameter is false . If the user moves to another device, the saved app data can be restored.
params.extends: String array (optional) List of ids of parent kinds from which the kind has been derived.
params.indexes: Object: IndexClause (optional) The indexes parameter contains indexes for the kind.
params.revsets: Object array: RevSetClause (optional) List of database revision sets.
params.private: Boolean (optional) Enable private data for putKind
params.assignId: Boolean (optional) Enable assign id for putKind if true

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/putKind (params copied from that record).

description: The putPermissions method enables other apps or services to access an app's stored DB8 data. The app can give permissions to access data objects of a specific Kind.

params.type: String (required) Must be set to db.kind .
params.object: String (required) The DB8 kind of the object for which the app wants to provide access.
params.caller: String (required) The id of the app or service that the app is granting permission to access its data.
params.operations: Object: operation (required) Database operations the app is granting permissions for.
params.create: String (optional) To grant create permission, set the create parameter to allow .
params.read: String (optional) To grant read permission, set the read parameter to allow .
params.update: String (optional) To grant update permission, set the update parameter to allow .
params.delete: String (optional) To grant delete permission, set the delete parameter to allow .

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/putPermissions (params copied from that record).

description: The removeAppData method removes all data associated with the given owner. In other words, the method removes all Kinds that have specified owner .

description: When a client service creates objects that have references between each other, the service can ask the database through the reserveIds method to regenerate ids of objects. The client service can use such ids as objects, and DB8 will use those ids when objects are inserted into the database. By default, DB8 configured to reserve maximum [0:1000] ids, but this limit can vary depending on the platform.

params.count: Number (required) Number of Ids to reserve.

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/reserveIds (params copied from that record).

description: Unlike the find method, the search method supports the "?" (question mark) operator. The ? operator can be used for full-text searching. However, the search method is significantly slower, and should only be used for full-text type-down search. The search method should not be used for retrieving results that are going to be scrolled in a list. The search method supports: Ordering by any property. Distinct method to remove duplicate objects. %% operator in filter to search in a sub-string. Canceling the search mid-way (using the 'cancelable' parameter). The search method has some limitations: There must be an index for the field you are searching on. The search operation looks for words beginning with the search string.

params.query: Object: Query (required) Query for search.
params.watch: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the app must be notified of any changes in the search results. This notification is sent only once (the first time when there is a change in the result). Possible values are: true - Notifies the changes. false - No notifications. Default value : false Note: The 'watch' and 'subscribe' parameters must not be used in the same call.
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscribe to get notified when there are changes in search results. Possible values are: true - Subscribe for changes. false - Not subscribed. Note : It is mandatory to set 'subscribe' to true when 'cancelable' is set to true . The 'watch' and 'subscribe' parameters must not be used in the same call.

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/search (params copied from that record).

description: Marks an external media as transient for the specified DB8 shard Id. This means that all data, relative to the shard, are not required by any application and will be removed by garbage collector. In other words, marking shard as transient will wipe all data from the shard on the nearest garbage collector call.

params.shardId: String (required) Base64 encoded id of shard
params.transient: Boolean (required) Mark shard as transient. Service can mark shard as not transient. If garbage collector didn't run, all data relative to shard, will not be removed.

notes: Listed under ACG group "tempdatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/setShardMode (params copied from that record).

notes: Errors: -101 app not found, -102 locked, -103 security check failed, -104 privileged dev-mode app, -105 invalid id. || SSAP path 'com.webos.applicationManager/launch' is addressed as service/method (full service name) per the secondscreen.gateway interface file format. Response includes processId (snabb/webostv). LGWebOSRemote exposes it as openAppWithPayload (used to start com.webos.app.factorywin with params {id:'executeFactory',irKey:'inStart'|'ezAdjust'}). Luna form luna://com.webos.applicationManager/launch is also used by root-side tools. || This is what webOS Dev Manager Desktop calls (pub=true) to extend the session. The same app also has a web renewal path: dev-manager-desktop renew script calls https://developer.lge.com/secure/ResetDevModeSession.dev?sessionToken=... with a token read from the TV. A rooted TV with /var/luna/preferences/devmode_enabled as a directory does not need renewal (webosbrew rooting notes). || The lowercase alias luna://com.webos.service.applicationmanager/launch and the camel alias luna://com.webos.service.applicationManager/launch are also used in the wild. Public callers can launch apps via luna-send-pub. Params examples: {"id":"com.palm.app.settings","params":{"target":"picture"}} (targets seen: picture, sound, channel, network, general, accessibility), {"id":"com.webos.app.browser","params":{"target":"https://..."}}, {"id":"com.webos.app.home","params":{"activateType":"home","launchType":"homeKey"}}, {"id":"com.webos.app.hdmi3} switches to HDMI 3 (Overglass notes HDMI inputs are com.webos.app.hdmi1..hdmi4; the Hearth/lumen docs switch inputs the same way). {"id":"X","params":{"hidden":true}} preloads an app hidden (Actually-Good-WebOS). {"restart":true} param plus keepAlive:true seen in webos-homebar. || Cheatsheet comments: ezAdjust is service menu 1, inStart is service menu 2, inStop is factory reset (question mark in source), pCheck overrides some picture settings for LCD testing, sCheck boosts sound to test audio, tilt opens a white screen that locks remote buttons until reboot. Passwords listed in source: 0413 (service menu), 1925 (Bang & Olufsen), 1126 ("USB Log"). homebridge-lgwebos-tv also lists "ServiceMenu": "com.webos.app.factorywin" as an app id. AVOID inStop. || Other tvhotkey activateType values seen in the Ircama gist: subtitle, multi-sound-setting, audio-description. com.webos.app.livemenu with activateType "channels"; com.webos.app.voice with {"activateType":"mrcu","launchMode":"vkb"}.

description: The compact method invokes the low level garbage collector. When DB8 executes a del operation without Purge:True param, it only marks the object as to be deleted. The object will be removed by DB8, when the garbage collector is called. To call the garbage collector manually, the client can call the compact method. This command is implemented only for the LevelDB and Sandwich engine.
notes: Listed under ACG group "epgdatabase.management" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/compact (params copied from that record).

description: The del method deletes JSON data objects from the database. Apps can specify the objects to be deleted by providing: a set of IDs to be deleted a DB8 query

params.ids: String array (optional) The ids parameter contains an array of JSON object ids that you wish to delete. If you do not wish to specify JSON object IDs, you must specify a query in the query parameter.

description: Unlike the find method, the search method supports the "?" (question mark) operator. The ? operator can be used for full-text searching. However, the search method is significantly slower, and should only be used for full-text type-down search. The search method should not be used for retrieving results that are going to be scrolled in a list. The search method supports: Ordering by any property. Distinct method to remove duplicate objects. %% operator in filter to search in a sub-string. Canceling the search mid-way (using the 'cancelable' parameter). The search method has some limitations: There must be an index for the field you are searching on. The search operation looks for words beginning with the search string.

params.watch: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the app must be notified of any changes in the search results. This notification is sent only once (the first time when there is a change in the result). params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscribe to get notified when there are changes in search results. Possible values are: true - Subscribe for changes. false - Not subscribed. description: Requests resources from the mediaserver. Typical usage is to request the number of audio and video decoders or other hardware components used by the pipeline. Acquire calls can be used to dynamically add more resources to the pipeline. This allows the pipeline to dynamically grow or shrink without monopolizing the resources from startup. Each time a resource is acquired, the indexes of the newly acquired resources are included in the acquireComplete event. Note: The types and quantities of resources available to be managed are specified in the file umediaserver_resource_config.txt.in file. This file is customized for each hardware platform. If required to satisfy the acquisition of requested resources, a policyAction may be issued to other pipelines, forcing them to release their resources. For format and list of acquired resources see acquireComplete event.

description: The detached event is raised when a specific media has been detached from the client by another client attaching to the corresponding pipeline. This feature is related to fast boot scenarios where we have a mini-app controlling media upon initial launch and the control is handed over to the real/full application once the system has started in full.

description: The mergePut method updates the properties of existing objects. If an object doesn't exist, a new one will be created in the database. The object to be updated can be specified in one of the following ways: A query An array of IDs

params.objects: Object array (optional) The object parameter is an array of objects, each object will have an id and key/value pairs that represent the object properties the app needs to merge. This is required if the query parameter is not specified.
params.query: Object: Query (optional) The query parameter is a Query object specifying the set of objects whose properties the app wants to update. The query parameter is required if the object parameter is not specified.
params.props: Object (optional) The props parameter is an object with key/value pairs that specify the set of properties to be merged into the existing object(s) specified in the query parameter. If the app specifies the properties in the prop parameter, the query is required.

notes: Listed under ACG group "mediadatabase.operation" in the component api.json/groups.json; no parameter docs read. Same method as com.webos.service.db/mergePut (params copied from that record).

description: Enables or disables DB8 profiling for an application. When enabled, profiling data is stored for the application. You can enable DB8 profiling using one of the following approaches: - Self enabling: In this approach, the 3rd-party application enables profiling on itself (see example 1). - Enable profiling using admin-privileged applications: In the approach, an admin-privileged application controls DB8 profiling for 3rd-party applications. Use this approach when you want the admin to control the profiling of 3rd-party applications. You can choose to enable profiling for a single application or for all 3rd-party applications. See example 2 and 3.

params.enable: Boolean (optional) Status of DB8 profiling. Possible values: TRUE, FALSE Default value: TRUE
params.application: String (optional) Name of application to be profiled. If no name is specified, the current/caller application is profiled. If name is given as *, all applications are profiled. The caller application must have admin permissions.

params.iconUrl: String (optional) The file path of the alert icon. The file path must be local to the device.
params.title: String (optional) A brief title for the alert notification.

params.modal: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether to display a modal or non-modal alert notification. Possible values are: true: Display a modal alert notification. false (Default): Display a non-modal alert notification.
params.buttons: Object array: button (required) Defines the button label, and onclick action. Button specification is given in an array. An example is: "buttons":[ {"label":"button1", "onclick":"luna://com.webos.service.applicationmanager/launch", "params":{"id":"com.webos.app.settings"}}, {"label":"button2", "focus":true}, {"label":"button3"} ]
params.onclose: Object: onclose (optional) Defines the close action to be performed when an alert is closed.
params.type: String (optional) Defines the button type in the alert. Possible values are: confirm (Default) warning
params.isSysReq: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether the notification has come from an app or system​. Possible values are: true: Notification comes from system. false: Notification comes from an app.
params.onfail: Object: onfail (optional) Action to be performed on failure to create an alert.

notes: ACG: notification.operation | Returns: alertId:String; returnValue:Boolean | Service: Manages the system notifications. || THE createAlert trick: the TV itself invokes the luna URI in onClick/onclose/onfail (see libs-notes.md). Returns alertId (e.g. com.webos.service.apiadapter-<n>; LG_Buddy also sees prefix com.webos.service.apiadapter.pub-). Needs permission WRITE_NOTIFICATION_ALERT / WRITE_NOTIFICATION_TOAST (LG_Buddy: omitting WRITE_NOTIFICATION_TOAST in the unsigned manifest makes createAlert return 401). webos-homebrew-channel's startup.sh calls luna://com.webos.notification/createAlert with buttons[{label,onclick,params}]. || Called as root with -a com.webos.service.secondscreen.gateway by Homebrew Channel/RootMyTV. Returns alertId. This is the mechanism bscpylgtv/ColorControl/LGTVCompanion abuse over SSAP (ssap://system.notifications/createAlert) to execute private luna calls: they put the target URI in buttons[0].onClick, onclose.uri and onfail.uri then closeAlert, so the private call runs without root. Returned data from the inner call is not visible.

returns.alertId: String (required) The ID of the created alert notification. This would be sourceId + "-" + Timestamp.

params.stale: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether the notification is old or current. Possible values are: true: Toast notification is old and does not need to be displayed. false (Default): Toast notification is current and should be displayed.

params.extra: Object array: image (optional) Defines extra toast resource.
params.onlyToast: Boolean (optional) Indicates if notification to be created is just a simple toast. Possible values are: true (Default): Shows simple information. false: Calls createNotification API and notiInfo is added in notification list.

notes: ACG: notification.operation | Returns: returnValue:Boolean; toastId:String | Service: Manages the system notifications. || Works from luna-send-pub (public) and root luna-send -a <appId>. Homebrew Channel, RootMyTV and the autoroot scripts use sourceId. Reply contains toastId (Overglass uses closeToast {toastId}). An alias luna://com.webos.service.notification/createToast and luna://com.webos.service.mrcu/createToast also appear. Lumen found a non-app caller can pass any app id as sourceId and the toast shows over a full-screen app. || SSAP alias system.notifications/createToast. Mapping to luna://com.webos.notification/createToast: webos-homebrew-channel calls luna://com.webos.notification/createToast with {message,...} directly (root/service context). homebridge-webos-tv documents params: message, iconData, iconExtension, onClick[appId, params]. Returns toastId.

returns.toastId: String (required) The id of the created toast notification. This would be sourceId + "-" + Timestamp.

description: Notifies ACR that an app closed. Name only.
versions: webOS TV (seen on W22O 7.0; behaviour from Glasshouse research across webOS 4-11); listed in webOS TV 7.0 (W22O 33.31.68) api-permissions.d
notes: ACR (Automatic Content Recognition, LG 'Live Plus') fingerprints what is on screen for LG's analytics/ads. Glasshouse's privacy research: the service is Type=dynamic, so any call (even a status query) starts it; a running acr2 is not proof it is collecting. With Live Plus and consents off it loaded no fingerprinting (Alphonso) library, opened no network sockets, and wrote no /tmp/acr.xml; it reads consent/country/device then checks sdx device-auth and stops if not provisioned. Documented so owners can audit it. || ACG groups: private, public, tv.services. Registered in on-disk api-permissions.d; the service may be dormant unless its context is active (e.g. Live TV, recording, a paired device).

An app or a service registers its willingness to become an Activity's parent, which means becoming an adopter. If there are adopters, all subscribers to this Activity receives an "orphan" event and the Activity is adopted to the new parent, one of the adopters. If there are no waiting adopters, all subscribers to this Activity receives a "cancel" event and the Activity disappears immediately.

description: Terminate the specified Activity and optionally restart it with(or without) new callback, schedule or trigger. Only the Activity's parent can call this method. Other subscribers to the Activity receive a "complete" event. If the Activity is persistent (i.e., persist in the Type object is set to true), the db8 is updated before the call returns. Note: The invocations to callback/triggers are constrained by ACG security model. It means that Activity Manager can invoke trigger/callback when both Activity Manager and activity creator have the permissions to those methods. Otherwise, the method fails with the error "'com.webos.service.activitymanager' doesn't have rights to call callback/trigger".

params.activityId: Number (uint64_t) (required) Activity ID. Note: Either activityId or activityName is a REQUIRED field.

To disable restart, set restart to false . The default value of restart is false . Note: If restart is false , this is equivalent to cancel . Therefore, it is recommended to always set restart to true to avoid confusion.

description: Creates a new alarm for an absolute time or a relative time. By using the " wakeup " parameter you can define it as a wake-up or a non-wakeup alarm.

params.key: String (required) Unique key to identify individual alarms.
params.at: String (required) The at parameter sets the absolute time, and must be in the format mm/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS to be passed. Note: Either this, or in is required.
params.in: String (required) The in parameter sets the relative time and must be in the format HH:MM:SS to be passed. Note: Either this, or at is required.
params.uri: String (required) The webOS API method that should be called when the alarm fires. Example: luna//com.webos.service.test/alarmFired
params.params: Object (required) Parameters that need to be passed with the uri when the alarm fires. Example: {"param1":"abc","param2":"xyz"}
params.wakeup: Boolean (optional) Specifies if the alarm is a wake-up alarm. Possible values are: true - Create a wake-up alarm, false - Create a non-wake up alarm Default value: false.

description: Adds a dynamic launchpoint. According to the information on launchpoint, application is displayed in the Launcher. If a parameter is not defined, SAM set the LP's parameter value same as appInfo's value.

params.id: String (required) Indicates the application ID to be added.
params.launchPointId: String (optional) Indicates the launchpoint ID to be added.
params.title: String (optional) Indicates the launchpoint title.
params.icon: String (optional) Indicates the path of the icon image displayed for the launchpoint.
params.bgImage: String (optional) Indicates the path of the background image displayed to the user when the user hovers over the launchpoint.
params.bgColor: String (optional) Indicates the background color for the launchpoint. It will be displayed when the bgImage is not provided or unable to display. A color can be specified as a hex value or as a HTML color name. Format: color hex code (ex. #000000(black)) http://www.color-hex.com/
params.imageForRecents: String (optional) Indicates the path of the image displayed in the "Recents" tile.
params.iconColor: String (optional) Indicates the background color for the application tile. The application tile is displayed in the Home, the Launcher, and the Recent screen. Format: color hex code (ex. #000000(black)) http://www.color-hex.com/
params.largeIcon: String (optional) Indicates the path of the large icon (130x130 pixels) displayed in the top left corner of the screen, when the user hovers over an application tile in the Launcher. Note : This file path is relative to the appinfo.json file.
params.appDescription: String (optional) Indicates a brief description for the launchpoint. Note : The appDescription cannot exceed 60 characters.
params.params: Object: params (optional) If params is used, it should contain information on the launchpoint.
params.bgImages: String array (optional) Indicates the paths of the background images displayed to the user when the user hovers over the launchpoint.
params.tileSize: String (optional) Indicates the tile size on UI. Possible values are normal large. Default: normal Note : The large tile hints that UI should make this tile larger than normal (2x). Usually, large size may be used for promotional application.
params.unmovable: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the launchpoint position is movable or not. Possible values are: true : The launchpoint position cannot be moved by the user. false : the launchpoint position can be moved by the user. Default: false
params.userData: String (optional) Indicates the additional data that may be used for analytical purposes. The userData will be logged when the user interacts with it in Launcher.
params.policyCategory: String (optional) Indicates the category(group) of the launch point. The value should be the one of below mapping table. *$RESERVED_VALUE is for special callers to be controlled by LPM. default Any 9 *$RESERVED_VALUE $RESERVED_LP $RESERVED_POSITION Value Launch Point Type position
params.supportI18nTitle: Boolean (optional) If "supportI18nTitle" is set to true , i18n will be supported for title when any information of this launch point is changed. If "supportI18nTitle" is set to false , i18n will be supported for title when any information of this launch point is changed. The default value of supportI18nTitle is true
params.favicon: String (optional) Indicates the paths of the favorite icon for the launchpoint.
params.relaunch: Boolean (optional) If it is set to true , the app will be fresh-launched(re-randering) whenever user clicks the launchpoint. Note : This parameter is deprecated in IvyLeague.

returns.launchPointId: String (optional) Indicates the launchpoint ID to be added.
returns.errorText: String (optional) Indicates the reason for the failure of the operation. See the "Error Codes" section of this method for details.
returns.errorCode: Number (optional) The error code for the failed operation.

description: Launches an application corresponding to the given application ID. Opens the service or app. Example: The user can download a content with a service in the background. Once the content is downloaded, the service must launch the app again. Parameter can be given in the JSON object during the launch of the application. The method can be called multiple times for the same application with different parameters. Application should handle these overtime requests. Generally, application is re-launched for every request. Note : At least one parameter is required. ('id', 'launchPointId', 'instanceId')

params.id: String (optional) Indicates the application ID to be launched.
params.launchPointId: String (optional) Indicates the launch point ID of the app.
params.instanceId: String (optional) Indicates the instance ID of the app.
params.params: Object: params (optional) If params is used, it should contain information on the target application. Specify correct parameters for each application. See the following parameter examples: YouTube application: "params":{ "contentTarget" : "https://www.youtube.com/tv?v=9bZkp7q19f0"} Today application: "params":{"type":"showRecordedList"}
params.keepAlive: Boolean (optional) Indicates the status of the application running in the background. Possible values are: true: To run the application in the background, set keepAlive to true . false: To terminate the application, set keepAlive to false . Default: keepAlive is set to false . description: Updates a dynamic launchpoint. Note: If a user changes the HDMI application icon to another icon like a game icon using Input Manager on a TV, the HDMI application icon is dynamically changed to the new icon on the launcher.

params.launchPointId: String (required) Indicates the launchpoint ID to be updated. Note : Both launchPointId and one or more parameters (title, icon, etc) need to be passed from service user.
params.title: String (optional) Indicates the launchpoint title.
params.icon: String (optional) Indicates the path of the icon image displayed for the launchpoint.
params.bgImage: String (optional) Indicates the path of the background image displayed to the user when the user hovers over the launchpoint. Format: color hex code (ex. #000000(black)) http://www.color-hex.com/
params.bgColor: String (optional) Indicates the background color for the launchpoint. It will be displayed when the bgImage is not provided or unable to display. A color can be specified as a hex value or as a HTML color name.
params.imageForRecents: String (optional) Indicates the path of the image displayed in the Recents tile.
params.iconColor: String (optional) Indicates the background color for the application tile. The application tile is displayed in the Home, the Launcher, and the Recent screen. Format: color hex code (ex. #000000(black)) http://www.color-hex.com/
params.largeIcon: String (optional) Indicates the path of the large icon (130x130 pixels) displayed in the top left corner of the screen, when the user hovers over an application tile in the Launcher. Note : This file path is relative to the appinfo.json file.
params.appDescription: String (optional) Indicates a brief description for the launchpoint. Note : The appDescription cannot exceed 60 characters.
params.params: Object: params (optional) If params is used, it should contain information on the launchpoint which will be passed to the application.
params.bgImages: String array (optional) Indicates the paths of the background images displayed to the user when the user hovers over the launchpoint.
params.tileSize: String (optional) Indicates the tile size on UI. Possible values are normal large. Default: normal Note : The large tile hints that UI should make this tile larger than normal (2x). Usually, large size may be used for promotional application.
params.unmovable: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the launchpoint position is movable or not. Possible values are: true : The launchpoint position cannot be moved by the user. false : the launchpoint position can be moved by the user. Default: false
params.userData: String (optional) Indicates the additional data that may be used for analytical purposes. Note : The userData will simply be logged when the user interacts with it in Launcher.
params.icons: Object array (optional) Indicates the list of icon images. Note : The icons will be shown in the launch point alternately.
params.favicon: String (optional) Indicates the favorite icon image displayed for the website.
params.policyCategory: String (optional) Indicate a category(group) of the launch point. The value should be the one of below mapping table. *$RESERVED_VALUE is for special callers to be controlled by LPM. Value Launch Point Type position default Any 9 *$RESERVED_VALUE $RESERVED_LP $RESERVED_POSITION
params.relaunch: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the target app is re-launched whenever the launch point is clicked. (Not fast-switching) Note: This parameter is deprecated in IvyLeague.

notes: ACG: application.launcher | Returns: returnValue:Boolean; errorCode:Number (int8_t); errorText:String | Service: Provides methods for managing application life cycle, application information, LaunchPoint list.

returns.errorCode: Number (int8\_t) (optional) The error code for the failed operation.
returns.errorText: String (optional) Indicates the reason for the failure of the operation. See the "API Error Codes Reference" section for more details.

params.subscribe: bool

returns.errorCode: Number (optional) Indicates the error code for the failed operation.
returns.result: String (optional) Indicates the result. Possible values are: - AF\_GRANTED - AudioFocusManager has granted the audio resource for the application and it can use the resource. - AF\_GRANTEDALREADY - This is sent when an application which has already acquired the audio resource calls the requestFocus method. This means, audio focus manager has already granted the audio resource and the application can use the resource. - AF\_CANNOTBEGRANTED - This means, audio resource is used by the other application which is having higher priority than the newly requested application. When this event is received the application should not use the resource.

description: Awaits incoming pairing requests on the default Bluetooth adapter (only) by setting its state to be pairable. The caller must subscribe to this method. It expects the caller will stay subscribed to this method across multiple pairing requests for as long as the webOS device wishes to accept pairing requests. Only one pairing request, either incoming or outgoing, can be active for an adapter at a given time. An outgoing pairing request is active until the service ends the subscription to adapter/pair by sending a subscription response containing request:endPairing . An incoming pairing request is active once a subscription response to this method contains request:displayPinCode , request:displayPasskey , request:confirmPasskey , request:enterPinCode , or request:enterPinCode . An incoming pairing request becomes inactive When a subscription response to this method contains request:endPair

description: Pairs a specific remote Bluetooth device with a specific Bluetooth adapter. The caller must subscribe to this method. Only one pairing request, either incoming or outgoing, can be active for an adapter at a given time. An outgoing pairing request is active until the service ends the subscription to this method by sending a subscription response containing request:endPairing . An incoming pairing request is active once a subscription response to adapter/awaitPairingRequests contains request:displayPinCode , request:displayPasskey , request:confirmPasskey , request:enterPinCode , or request:enterPinCode . An incoming pairing becomes inactive when a subscription response contains request:endPairing . If the client calls LSCallCancel() , the pairing is canceled the same way as if adapter/cancelPairing had been called. Note: A remote device can only be paired to a single adapter.

params.adapterAddress: String (optional) Indicates the address of the adapter. Note: If not specified, the address of the default adapter will be used. If the service is part of a container session, do not specify adapterAddress. Based on the session, by default, a pre-selected adapterAddress is used.

description: Gets the items in the current folder of the media player's virtual filesystem presented by AVRCP TG. It takes startIndex and endIndex as argument and gets the items within this range. It is recommended to fetch a part of the list at a time and update it as user scrolls the display to avoid any delay in fetching the items from AVRCP_TG and displaying the items. This can be done by specifying the range using startIndex and endIndex. endIndex should be less than total number of items received using getNumberOfItems API. Application should not call getFolderItems API if the folder is empty.

Note : endIndex should be greater than or equal to startIndex ( endIndex = startIndex means you are requesting one item that is at index endIndex/startIndex) and less than total number of items in the current folder.

description: Refreshes the mesh network key and associated app keys.

params.subscribe: Boolean (required) Subscribe for notifications about any failure during the key refresh procedure. Possible values are: true: Subscribed. false: Not subscribed. For example: If app key update to the remote node fails during the key refresh procedure, it informs the application using subscription response and the key refresh procedure continues for the remaining nodes.
params.adapterAddress: String (optional) The address of the adapter. Note: If not specified, the default adapter is used.
params.bearer: String (optional) The underlying bearer to use. Possible values are: PB-ADV (default) PB-GATT (Currently not supported)
params.blacklistedNodes: Number array (optional) Provide a list of blacklistedNodes, represented by the primary element address of the node. Note: Blacklisted nodes will not receive new app/network keys during the keyRefresh process.
params.waitTimeout: Number (optional) The total duration (in seconds) to wait for each phase to complete during keyRefresh process. The application has to provide a time considering the low power nodes in the network as they may take longer to respond. Note: If not specified, a default timeout time of 2 seconds is used.
params.refreshAppKeys: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether to refresh appkeys associated with net key indicated by netKeyIndex true: Refresh app keys (List the app keys to refresh in "appKeyIndexes" field) false: Do not Refresh app keys Note: If not specified, the default value false is used. Use case 1: When an application had called removeNode API to remove a node from the network, it can refresh only those app keys
params.appKeyIndexes: Number array (optional) Provide app key indexes to refresh. This parameter is ignored if refreshAppKeys is false. Note: If refreshAppKeys is true, and an empty array is passed, or if this field is not provided, all app keys will be refreshed by default. List of appkeys known to a node can be fetched by calling mesh/listProvisionedNodes API before removing a particular node.

description: Receive data from the connected remote device.

params.channelId: String (optional) Unique ID of a SPP channel. If channelId is not specified, all connected channel IDs from which the caller received data will be returned.
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) To read the data continuously, set subscribe to true . Otherwise, set subscribe to false . The default value of subscribe is true .
params.timeout: Number (optional) The receive timeout in seconds. It is available only when subscribe is set to true . After timeout seconds, the subscription is canceled. A value of 0 means that the timeout is disabled.
params.adapterAddress: String (optional) The address of the adapter executing this method. If not specified, the default adapter will be used.

description: It returns the requested configs which is the pairs of key-value as a JSON object and also supports a subscription. configd provides asterisk but configNames should starts feature file name. description: The compact method invokes the low level garbage collector. When DB8 executes a del operation without Purge:True param, it only marks the object as to be deleted. description: The find method returns a set of objects that match the query specified in the query parameter. The app can specify the number of results to return. However, if the app does not want to specify a limit, it can set the count parameter to true . This will cause the find method to return the total number of results. The app can also request to be notified if any of the returned results from the query change in the future. In order to receive change notifications, set the watch parameter to true . The find method supports distinct groups enabling the app to remove duplicate objects.

description: The putKind method registers a kind with the database. Kinds define the owner, and the indexes for a JSON data object. Indexes can be composed of single or multiple properties. When you create your index, be aware that queries can only return results that are indexed, and are contiguously ordered. If your app or service wants to be notified only when a subset of an object's properties are updated, then you can use revision sets. If your app or service creates objects that other apps or services need to access, then see the putPermissions method for more information.

params.id: String (required) Id of the kind to be registered with the database.
params.owner: String (required) Owner of the kind. Only the owner has permission to modify the created kind. Use the ID of the app/service which calls the putKind method. description: Unlike the find method, the search method supports the "?" (question mark) operator. The ? operator can be used for full-text searching. However, the search method is significantly slower, and should only be used for full-text type-down search. The search method should not be used for retrieving results that are going to be scrolled in a list. The search method supports: Ordering by any property. Distinct method to remove duplicate objects. %% operator in filter to search in a sub-string. Canceling the search mid-way (using the 'cancelable' parameter). The search method has some limitations: There must be an index for the field you are searching on. The search operation looks for words beginning with the search string.

params.query: Object: Query (required) Query for search.
params.watch: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the app must be notified of any changes in the search results. This notification is sent only once (the first time when there is a change in the result). Possible values are: true - Notifies the changes. false - No notifications. Default value : false Note: The 'watch' and 'subscribe' parameters must not be used in the same call.
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscribe to get notified when there are changes in search results. Possible values are: true - Subscribe for changes. false - Not subscribed. Note : It is mandatory to set 'subscribe' to true when 'cancelable' is set to true . The 'watch' and 'subscribe' parameters must not be used in the same call.

LGWebOSRemote sends it with the uri written directly as luna://com.webos.service.eim/setDeviceInfo. description: Allows apps to modify the parameters of a cache type other than its name. You must specify the name of the cache type, and those cache type parameters that have to be modified. The cache type values are all as defined in DefineType .

params.typeName: String (required) Name of cache type to be modified.
params.loWatermark: Number (optional) The minimum space in bytes guaranteed to be available for this cache type.
params.hiWatermark: Number (optional) The maximum space in bytes allowed to be used by this cache type.
params.size: Number (optional) Default value in bytes for any object inserted into this cache type that does not specify a value for size. Size must not be negative.
params.cost: Number (optional) Default value between 0 and 100 for any object inserted into this cache type that does not specify a value for cost.
params.lifetime: Number (optional) Default value in seconds for any object inserted into this cache type that does not specify a value for lifetime. lifetime must not be negative.

description: Enables copying of an object from the file cache to a non-cached location. On successful completion, newPathName will be returned as it may be different than expected due to filename collisions. If there is a name collision, the name will be made unique by adding a number to the file basename (i.e. foo.bar may become foo-(1).bar).

params.pathName: String (required) The pathName is the path of the cache object to be copied
params.destination: String (optional) The destination is the path to a target directory, this path will be validated to ensure you have write permissions to that directory.
params.fileName: String (optional) The fileName is the name for the target file. If not passed, the fileName will be the value passed when calling InsertCacheObject .

returns.errorCode: Number (optional) The error code for the failed operation.
returns.errorText: String (optional) Indicates the reason for the failure of the operation. See the " Error Codes Reference" section of this method for details.

description: Defines a new cache type. This is intended for use by the backup service. Optionally you may specify the default values for the size, cost, and lifetime. These defaults will be applied to all objects inserted into this cache type that do not specify their own values for these arguments. The size is in bytes, the cost is an integer between 0 and 100, and the lifetime is in seconds. The errorCode and errorText are only be returned if the returnValue is false. Note: You can not define type with the same typeName . Use changeType to change an existing type.

params.typeName: String (required) A typeName is a string up to 64 characters that uniquely identifies the new cache type. A typeName cannot start with a . ( the period character).
params.loWatermark: Number (required) The minimum space in bytes guaranteed to be available for the cache type.
params.hiWatermark: Number (required) The maximum space in bytes allowed to be used by the cache type.
params.size: Number (optional) Default value in bytes for any object inserted into the cache type that does not specify a value for size .
params.cost: Number (optional) Default value between 0 and 100 for any object inserted into this cache type that does not specify a value for cost .
params.lifetime: Number (optional) Default value in seconds for any object inserted into this cache type that does not specify a value for lifetime .
params.dirType: Boolean (optional) Specifies whether the cache type should create directory entries. This is intended for use by the backup service.

description: Objects will normally be automatically expired form the cache as space is needed. If you want to force an item to be removed or if you want to remove items prior to calling DeleteType , you can expire an object manually. The ExpireCacheObject method will not actually remove a subscribed object from the cache, but will mark the object for removal. The object is physically removed, when it has no active subscriptions. NOTE : By default, objects in a cache type will be automatically expired from the cache as space is needed.

params.pathName: String (required) Path of the object to be manually expired.

description: Inserts a new object of the specified type into the cache. The fileName parameter is required. It is stored with the object to ensure that the correct extension is provided, so that other module can choose a strategy to process this file (for example, choose the file viewer matching the extension). Other parameters are optional. If not provided, the cache type default values defined are be used. Returned is the path to the object in the cache. The subscribe setting should be set to true so that after the object is inserted you can write the file.

params.typeName: String (required) The cache type of the object being inserted.
params.fileName: String (required) The fileName is stored with the object and is used to ensure the correct extension is provided on the cache object. The fileName will help any code, for example, one that determines a file viewer, to operate correctly on a cached object file.
params.size: Number (optional) The size is a value in bytes, should be greater than zero. Note that, size parameter is required, if type has no default size.
params.cost: Number (optional) The cost is a number between 1 and 100.
params.lifetime: Number (optional) The lifetime is value in seconds.
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscribe should be set to true so that after the object is inserted one can continues to make updates to the file.

description: By calling the ResizeCacheObject you can specify the size of the cached object after it is inserted into the cache. Call this method if the final size of the object, which is being inserted into the cache, is not known by the moment, when you call the InsertCacheObject method. In this case: Call the InsertCacheObject method specifying the best approximate object size you can guess. Then call the ResizeCacheObject method on a subscribed object, if the the object size grows out of the previously specified size. If the object is larger than the specified size when the write operation is complete, the object will be automatically removed from the cache. If the object is smaller than the specified size, the recorded object size will be adjusted to the correct size. Remark: it is not a good practice to just specify a larger than expected size though as this could cause other objects to be expi

params.pathName: String (required) The path of the object to be resized.
params.newSize: Number (required) The new size of the object in bytes.

description: Gets the current status of the GPS engine. Used for notifying device users that the GPS engine has started or stopped. GPS engine is started when a method that needs the engine to work is called. GPS engine is turned off when all the received requests have been handled or canceled, thus when there is nothing left for it to do. System-wise, when all luna-commands related to the engine starting are canceled, the GPS engine is powered OFF . Prerequisite: For getGpsStatus method to work, the GPS feature of the device has to be powered ON .

params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Subscribe for notifications. Possible values are: true: Get notifications. false: Notifications are not required. Default: true

description: "Ping" an IPv4 network address or hostname to determine if it is reachable. The maximum wait time is 5 seconds. The implementation uses a call to the system ping command: "ping -c 1 -w 5 hostname ifName". Note: To ping an IPv6 address, use the ping6() method.

params.hostname: String (required) Indicates the hostname or network address to ping. Network address must be IPv4, IPv6 is not supported. Example: www.lge.com or 10.10.1.1
params.ifName: String (optional) Interface on which to issue the ping. Example: eth0 Note : If unspecified it will use the interface with the default gateway.

returns.time: Number (optional) Indicates the time taken for the ping response.
returns.hostname: String (optional) Indicates the hostname or network address used for ping.
returns.bytes: Number (optional) Indicates the number of bytes - Ping packet size.
returns.ttl: Number (optional) Indicates the time to live.

description: Pings an IPv6 network address or host name to determine if it is reachable. The maximum amount of time the ping waits for a reply is 5 seconds. Internally, the implementation uses a call to the system ping command: "ping6 -c 1 -w 5 hostname ifName". Note: To ping an IPv4 address, use the ping() method.

params.hostname: String (required) Indicates the hostname or the network address to ping. Note : It must be a valid IPv6 address. Example : ac78::cgff:baff:eghh:hh05
params.ifName: String (optional) Indicates the interface through which the ping is to be issued. Example : eth0 Note : By default, the ping is issued on the default gateway.

description: Performs a DNS request to resolve hostname to list all IP addresses that it maps to. This will return IPv4 or IPv6 addresses depending upon what the network interface supports. The implementation uses a call to the POSIX.1-2001 getaddrinfo() function, please refer to RFC 2553 (https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2553.txt).

params.hostname: String (required) Indicates the hostname to be resolved. The hostname must start with "www." and must end with one of the following: .org .com .net .gov .edu .jp .int .mil Example: www.lge.com

description: Clients can register to get notified when the state changes from a specified state. For example, if registered to get notifications on state “ACTIVE”, you will get notified when state changes from “ACTIVE” to any other state. Some transitions require acceptance (acknowledgement) from all clients who register to this state. For this check the respondStateTransitionAck() method. Note: It is a subscription method. Subscription is notified when specified state change happens. setState method can be used for state change forcefully.

params.state: String (required) State for which to register.

description: For clients that have registered for state change notifications, some state transitions require acceptance (acknowledgement) of all clients who register for this state : If all subscribers approve (ACK), the state change occurs. If even one subscriber rejects (NACK), the state does not change. Clients who have not subscribed to that state are not required to vote. No user input is considered as acceptance of the state change.

params.ack: Boolean (required) Client vote. Possible values are: true - positive acknowledgement (ACK) confirming the state transition. false - negative acknowledgement (NACK) to reject the state transition.
params.token: String (required) Session token generated in response to the registerStateTransition() method.

notes: ACG: power.management | Returns: returnValue:Boolean; errorCode:Number; errorText:String | Service: Allows client applications to power-on, power-off, and perform other power-related operations on the device.

description: Sets the state of the device. This method forcefully sets the state and ignores the sequential flow of power states. This means that the client is not prompted for acknowledgement, even if you have registered for state change notifications (using registerStateTransition() method). Note: This method can also reboot or shutdown the device. However, it is advisable to use the specific methods provided for these purposes.

params.reason: Number (required) The event that caused the state change. Possible values are: 0 - wake on LAN via external device network 1 - wake on WiFi via external device network 2 - power on/off by remote 3 - power on by on timer

description: Shuts down the device. Note : Client will be prompted for acknowledgement if registered for state change notifications. This shutdown API will work differently for ose. If it is in ActiveState, it may go garage state base if it met preconditions i.e wifi on and SSID. (garageSSID can be configured in /var/PMS/pms.conf). Shuts down the device with in timeout after acknowledged from connection manager service(Precondition not met). LunaInterfacePMSRoot:TimeOut is configured in /var/PMS/pms.conf file as 15mins by default. Timeout is in HH:MM:SS format

params.reason: String (required) The event that causes the device to be shutdown. Possible values are: remoteKey - Power off using remote control offTimer - Power off using OFF timer localKey - Power off using using the devices hardware power on/off key diagnosticsDone - Power off device when diagnostics operation done

description: Set picture-quality controller properties; used to trigger USB Dolby Vision config Update/Restore

Not exposed as an SSAP method; reachable without root only through the createAlert/closeAlert trick (see libs-notes.md): the alert button onClick/onclose/onfail luna URI is invoked by the TV; response data is NOT returned to the websocket client.

description: The getSomeSysProperties method takes an object array of property keys and returns an array of objects with key-value pairs for each of the keys. The getSomeSysProperties method returns the equivalent to what getSysProperty would have returned for each key. If one of the keys fails, an error is returned in that element of the array but the rest go through. Note: On a successful return, there will be no returnValue and the returned object will only be an array of JSON objects containing key/value pairs.

params.key: String (required) A JSON array of keys for which the key-value pairs are returned. Note: The parameter is an array: ["k1", "k2"], and not an object: [{"key": "k1"}, {"key": "k2"}]

description: The preBackup method creates dump files containing platform-specific environment settings. Call this method before executing the backup procedure in order to save these settings. The dump files are saved into the directory specified by the temp_dir parameter or '${localstatedir}/preferences' . The list of the platform-specific settings that are saved in the dump file is specified in the sysservice-backupkeys.json file. Below is an example of this file: [ "useNetworkTime", "useNetworkTimeZone", "timeZone", "timeChangeLaunch", "showcontactmatch", "x_webos_virtualkeyboard_prefs" ] If any of the method parameters is not specified or specified incorrectly, the method will use the default values. This method is internal, only system applications can use it. It is not available to third-party applications.

params.incrementalKey: object (optional) This is used primarily for mojodb, backup service will handle other incremental backups.
params.maxTempBytes: number (optional) The allowed size of upload. It is currently set at 10MB.
params.tempDir: String (optional) Directory to store temporarily generated files.

description: The getTime method gets the current time for a specific time source. There are several time data sources on the system: Linux system time, user time, network-broadcast time and more. When calling this method, you can specify the desired time data source in the source parameter. The complete list of the data sources is listed in the source parameter description below. Any application can use this method.

params.source: String (optional) Time-source to access (default "system") Supported sources: system - Linux system-wide time (always available) manual - Last time set manually by user sdp - time received with session initialization to server (ex. device membership registration) ntp - time periodically or by request received from NTP (Network Time Protocol) service nitz - time received over NITZ (Network Identity
params.manualOverride: Boolean (optional) If manualOverride set to false means that source shouldn't be overriden by manual time when useNetworkTime is turned to false (use the time user specified manually). If useNetworkTime is set to false and manualOverride is set to true , get time specified in source parameter. If useNetworkTime is set to false and manualOverride is set to false , ignore the time in the source para
params.fallback: String (optional) Fall-back time source to use when requested one is missing. If not set and time-source specified in "source" is missing request will fail (unless overridden by manual time).

notes: ACG: time.query | Returns: returnValue:Boolean; source:String; utc:Number; offset:Object: TimeSourceOffset; systemTimeSource:String; priority:Number; timestamp:Object: Timestamp; errorCode:Number; errorText:String | Service: Provides access to the webOS system settings such as: Backup options Getting device information Getting and modifying the date and time settings Setting ringtones Wallpaper Local formats

returns.source: String (required) Actual time source associated with result (either one specified in source or in fallback or manual if overridden).
returns.utc: Number (optional) Seconds since epoch for UTC.
returns.offset: Object: TimeSourceOffset (optional) Offset from some other time source (usually from system).
returns.systemTimeSource: String (optional) If system-wide system time is returned and this field is present, it will denote last time source used for system time synchronization.
returns.priority: Number (optional) Priority of returned time source (with higher level overrides one with lower).
returns.errorCode: Number (optional) The error code for the failed operation.
returns.errorText: String (optional) Indicates the reason for the failure of the operation. See the " Error Codes Reference" section of this method for details.

description: The setTime method is used to set the time. By calling this method you can update any time data source, including Linux system time, network-broadcasted time, user time and others. Any application can use this method. After this method is called, the system services receives a notification about the time update.

params.utc: Number (required) Seconds since epoch in UTC time-zone. Note: Either utc field or available field is mandatory.
params.source: String (optional) Time source associated with time info update (default "manual"). Only those sources that are listed in the timeSources Preference key can be set.

params.timestamp: Object: Timestamp (optional) Monotonic timestamp. If set, will be used to calculate a delay between sending and receipt of this request over luna-bus and add that to utc field.

description: The time/getSystemTime method gets the system time and time zone information. Apps can susbcribe to this method and receive notifications when the time zone changes and/or the system time changes by a significant amount (currently 5 min.). This method does not generate errors, however if the LSSubscriptionAdd method, which is used inside the getSystemTime method, returns an error, this error is reported.

params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) If the app wants to receive notifications when the time zone changes and/or the system time changes by a system-defined threshold, it should set subscribe to true. The current system-defined threshold is 5 minutes. If the app does not wish to receive notifications of change in time zone and/or the system time changes, it should set subscribe ​ to false .

description: The setSystemNetworkTime method is used to send a NITZ messages to Luna System Service. A NITZ message contains the local time and date, time zone and DST offset, as well as network provider identity. NITZ can be used to update the system clock of network devices. This method is called by the service, which receives the time data from the service provider.

params.year: String (required) Year calculated from 1900, for example 2012 - 1900 = 112.
params.offset: String (required) Offset from GMT time in minutes.
params.mnc: String (required) Network code assign to carrier within a country
params.tzvalid: Boolean (required) Is set to true of if timezone is valid. If false, mcc and offset are used to calculate time.
params.dstvalid: Boolean (required) Is daylight saving time in use.
params.dst: Number (int32_t) (required) If this is 1, month needs to be set within the timeframe of DaylightSavingTime (~April - ~Septermber). If this is 0, months needs to be specified outside of DaylightSavingTime ( ~November - February).
params.timestamp: String (required) Timestamp of current time. Can be number of ticks from system boot. The number is used to calculate delay of message delivery
params.tilIgnore: Boolean (required) Set as true if you wish to test this service with a fake NITZ message.

description: Gets the time-zone that matches the provided EAS data. This method enables you to determine the time zone by the specified time stamp.

params.bias: Number (required) Number of minutes that a time zone is offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
params.standardDate: Object: EasLocalTime (optional) Object containing date and time information in standard time. If any of the fields for EasLocalTime structure are missing or out of range, this field is ignored as not specified. This field should be specified in combination with daylightDate . If either standardDate or daylightDate is not specified, both fields are ignored as not specified.
params.standardBias: Number (optional) The standardBias is the bias value to be used for local time translations that occur during standard time. This value is added to the value of the bias member to form the bias used during standard time. In most time zones, the value is zero. This field is not used in calculations for the moment.
params.daylightDate: Object: EasLocalTime (optional) The daylightDate is an object containing the date and time information in daylight saving time. If any of the fields for EasLocalTime structure are missing or out of range, this field is ignored as not specified. This field should be specified in combination with standardDate . If either standardDate or daylightDate is not specified, both are ignored as not specifie
params.daylightBias: Number (optional) The dayLightBias is the bias value to be used for local time translations that occur during daylight saving time. This value is added to the value of the bias member to form the bias used during daylight saving time. In most time zones, the value is –60. This field is not used in calculations for the moment.

returns.timeZone: String (optional) The timezone matching the given parameters. Note: When there are multiple locations that match the specified "bias", the entry that first appears in the preferences is returned. For example, Gibraltar and Brussles, both have offset from UTC as 60. So, if bias is given as "-60", the API returns timezone as "Gibraltar" since it appears before "Brussels". This order can be checked in the output of the following command: # luna-send -n 1 -f luna://com.webos.service.systemservice/getPreferenceValues '{"key": "timeZone" }'

description: The convert method converts an image. The type, scaling and centering of the image may be changed. If the resulting image is smaller than the original, black is added to the edges so that the resulting image is the same size as the original. If the resulting image would be bigger than the original, the image is cropped. JPG, PNG and BMP files are supported.

params.focusY: Number (optional) The vertical coordinate of the new center of the image, from 0.0 (top edge) to 1.0 (bottom edge). A value of 0.5 preserves the current vertical center of the image.
params.scale: Number (optional) Scale factor for the image, must be greater than zero.

description: The importWallpaper method is used to convert the specified image into a device wallpaper. To convert into a wallpaper the image is either re-centered and cropped, or scaled. Once the image has been converted, the wallpaper is stored in the internal list of wallpapers on the device, and is available until deleted using deleteWallpaper method. Focus Parameter Scale Parameter Conversion Method Yes No The image is re-centered at the point specified by the focus parameters and cropped. Gaps are filled with Black color if the image does not reach the edge of the screen. No Yes The image is scaled and then cropped Yes Yes The image is first scaled and then re-centered and cropped No No Scales the image to fill the screen

description: Reads out an input text in the language chosen by the user. Note : It generates a series of audio as output sounds until the complete speech signal for the input text is synthesized.

params.text: String (required) Indicates the text to be converted. Note : The expected character encoding is platform-endian UTF-8.
params.clear: Boolean (optional) Indicates if the current text is to be cleared. Possible values are: true : Stops processing the current text, and processes the next one. false : Processes the next text only after completing the current one. Default: false
params.subscribe: Boolean (optional) Indicates if subscribed to get the notifications. Possible values are: true: Subscribe for notifications false: Not subscribed Default: false
params.language: String (optional) Indicates the language used to read the input text. Note: To get the list supported languages, use the getAvailableLanguages() method. The default language is English (en-US).
params.appID: String (optional) Indicates the Application ID. Example: com.webos.app.voice
params.feedback: Boolean (optional) Indicates if a unique identifier is to be returned for the input text. Possible values are: true : Provides msgIDs for texts. false : Does not provide identifiers for texts. Default: false
params.displayId: Number (optional) Indicates the unique identifier for the displays. Possible values are: 0: display 1 1: display 2 Default: 0

notes: ACG: tts.operation | Returns: returnValue:Boolean; errorCode:Number; errorText:String; msgID:String; language:String | Service: Converts plain language text into speech output. The synthesized speech can be used by applications such as voice assistants. || Error 8101 unless option.audioGuidance is on.

returns.errorCode: Number (optional) The error code for the failed operation.
returns.errorText: String (optional) Indicates the reason for the failure of the operation. See the "API Error Codes Reference" section for details.
returns.msgID: String (optional) Indicates the unique identifier containing 12 characters that represent the input text. Note: The value is returned only if the feedback is set to true.
returns.language: String (optional) Indicates the language used to process the input text.

description: Stops the text-to-speech processing immediately and ignores the pending text on the buffer. Note : There could be some noise in the output when the service is stopped abruptly. To avoid this, set the fadeOut parameter to true . This will gradually reduce the output sound to zero without any noise. If both appID and msgID are passed in the API call, it considers only the msgID and stops the service based on the value provided by the msgID.

params.appID: String (optional) Indicates the Application ID passed in the speak() method.
params.msgID: String (optional) Indicates the unique identifier containing 12 characters that represent the input text.
params.fadeOut: Boolean (optional) Reduces the output sound without any noise. Possible values are: true : Gradually reduces the output sound to zero. false : Immediately stops the speech processing. This can result in unwanted noise. Default: true
params.displayId: Number (optional) Indicates the unique identifier for the displays. Possible values are: 0: display 1 1: display 2 Default: 0

description: Returns why the TV was last powered on (e.g. ON_BY_REMOTE_KEY)
Returns uptime since boot in seconds
Get (or subscribe to) TV power state

params.subscribe: bool

notes: state values seen in sources: 'Active', 'Active Standby', 'Suspend', 'Screen Off', 'Power Off', 'Unknown' (bscpylgtv is_on/is_screen_on logic; lgtv2 README). snabb/webostv recorded '404 no such service or method' for this URI on its (older) test TV. || state strings seen: Active, Screen Saver, Screen Off, Active Standby. Glasshouse treats Active/Screen Saver as on. Also power2/getPowerState exists on newer firmware.

description: Puts the TV into standby (quick-start suspend when Quick Start+ is on)
notes: With Quick Start+ on this only suspends: Wake-on-LAN wakes it in seconds.

description: Brings a TV back from Active Standby/Always-on
notes: Only reachable while in Active Standby.

versions: webOS 3-4 (variant tv.power/reboot on 5+); older webOS only
notes: Homebrew Channel uses reason:"cpuCommand" and falls back to /sbin reboot. bscpylgtv warns it no longer works via the alert hack on newer webOS. || Called with {'reason':'remoteKey'}. bscpylgtv `reboot_soft`: 'does not work anymore on newer WebOS versions'. Not exposed as an SSAP method; reachable without root only through the createAlert/closeAlert trick (see libs-notes.md): the alert button onClick/onclose/onfail luna URI is invoked by the TV; response data is NOT returned to the websocket client.

description: Launches an application by the app ID. Note : This is the major function used by the SAM to request for launching an application.

description: Connects to a given SSID, which can be an open network requiring no passphrase (i.e no security field in its argument), hidden network(requiring wasCreatedWithJoinOther field set to true in its argument), secure networks (authenticating with the specified passphrase), or enterprise networks(currently supported EAP methods are: PEAP, TLS and TTLS). Upon successful connection, the Wi-Fi profile is saved on the system along with its SSID and security details. On the other hand, if the connection is unsuccessful but the parameter storeProfile is set to true then the Wi-Fi profile is still saved on the system along with the connman .config file, which enables connman to connect to this network once it is available. To connect to an already known network i.e a saved profile , the profileId parameter should be set.

params.ssid: String (optional) SSID of the desired network. Required for all connections except when using a known profile ( profileId parameter is set).
params.wasCreatedWithJoinOther: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether to connect to a hidden network. Possible values are: true - Connect to a hidden network false - Connect to a non-hidden network Default value : false
params.storeProfile: Boolean (optional) Indicates whether to store a profile for the network when it is not available (i.e out of range). Possible values are: true - Store a profile false - Ignore a profile Default value: true
params.security: Object: security (optional) Set to connect to a secured network.
params.profileId: number (optional) ID of the desired profile, which can be obtained from the getprofilelist call. Required to connect with a known profile.

description: Sets the Wi-Fi tethering state. Wi-Fi tethering can either be enabled or disabled. At least the ssid field needs to be set before enabling tethering. This can be done either with a separate setState call or within the enable call. The "ssid", "securityType" and "passPhrase" configuration values are persisted across device reboots. params.enabled: Boolean (optional) Enable or disable Wi-Fi tethering.
